interventions.speaker: CHAIR
interventions.who: the senior urologist who signs the decision
interventions.body: The prognosis is influenced by several factors, including a preoperative PSA of 6.5 and positive surgical margins. The pathological findings show an ISUP grade group 2 (Gleason 3+4) with no extraprostatic extension and no seminal vesicle invasion. A key limitation is the absence of nodal sampling; therefore, pNx status cannot be definitively classified as pN0. Biopsy-to-prostatectomy differences exist, with biopsy showing Gleason 3+3 (ISUP group 1) compared to the prostatectomy grade of ISUP group 2. The lack of documented seminal vesicle invasion is a favorable finding. Prognostic assessment is significantly limited by missing postoperative PSA data and follow-up information. Future trajectory would be substantially revised by obtaining serial measurements of the postoperative PSA, particularly its rate of change over time. The fixed estimated horizon is 62.79 months. This represents expected follow-up without an event, not a known recurrence date. The sensitivity range is 37.67–87.91 months; its coverage has not been validated.
